description: Estimated q=2 asymptote A: the reciprocal of the corrected concentration sum(n(n-1)) / (N(N-1)), when that is positive. Reciprocal expected Simpson concentration at support depth m is m / (1 + (m - 1) / A), which reaches 95 per cent of A at the continuous depth 19 * (A - 1) when A > 1. If A = 1, every positive draw has diversity one and already exceeds 95 per cent of A. That depth can exceed observed support and is not a required FASTQ depth. A is a model-based plateau, not an unbiased diversity estimate. Empty unless asymptote_status is available; not masked by the configured diversity minimum.
denominator: N * (N - 1) for the corrected concentration, where N is grouped_consensus_count in this library and locus

The top_1_support_fraction, top_5_support_fraction and top_10_support_fraction values in diversity do not depend on how ties are broken, because tied groups carry equal support. Rows of a library and locus are ordered by group_rank, then by clonotype_key at the non-IGH loci, or by the clone's smallest member junction in this library and then clone_id at IGH.

Number of finite non-zero nearest-neighbour junction distances returned by SHazaM for the donor's members. Comparisons require equal junction length and identical resolved V/J entities. Number of distances SHazaM findThreshold fitted: n_distances, capped at params.lineage.fit_subsample when that setting is not null. Empty when no fit was attempted, which is when fit_status is too_few_distances or constant_distances.

Outcome of the donor fit. fitted: at least params.lineage.min_fit_distances distances, not all equal, and a finite gamma-normal cutoff from 0 to 1. too_few_distances: fewer distances than that minimum. constant_distances: enough distances, all equal. fit_failed: SHazaM findThreshold raised an error or returned no finite cutoff. out_of_range: a finite cutoff outside 0 to 1. Only fitted donors inform the automatic scope threshold, and every donor's records are clustered at the scope threshold.

Gamma-normal mixture cutoff at params.lineage.fit_specificity. Specificity is the far component mass between the cutoff and the largest fitted distance divided by its mass between the smallest and largest fitted distances. It is a model quantity, not empirical clone-assignment accuracy. Empty unless fit_status is fitted. Donor fits run even when a configured numeric threshold determines clone assignment.

These describe the original assembly consensus at each position, whereas consensus_count records CDR3 support for one reported record. Unmapped positions contain the literal token NA. The internal grouping tables write it as ineligible_backbone_representative.
